body:
## Found during M7.P5 UI qualification

Parent #344; discovered while checking #535/#537 against the maintainer request:

> Let’s get all of the fixes and changes made, if we’ve tracked everything down

The inherited French on-screen keyboard shows RÉINITIALISER overlapping ANNULER at1280×800. The same RESET action in both ES text editors actually commits an empty string, so CLEAR / EFFACER describes its behavior more precisely and fits. This is a caption-only fix to the shared text-editor clear action; unrelated RESET actions and callbacks stay as they are.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes. Retain the original French frame, compile the two edited ES units, and exercise clear/cancel in an owned synthetic VM at640×480 and1280×800. No owner device or cloud data is involved.

Already written: the inherited keyboard has a long French reset label; selecting it empties the edited setting. No saved data is changed by the caption fix.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] The two text editors label their existing empty-string action CLEAR / EFFACER; other RESET actions and action callbacks are unchanged, verified by source diff and syntax checks.
- [x] Reviewed EN/FR640/1280 VM frames show clear and cancel labels separately; actual clear and cancel callbacks preserve the established behavior.
- [x] Canonical flow/frame references, changelog and source-bound receipts accompany the next ES pin. Original rejected overlap frame stays recorded.

## Implemented and locally verified — 2026-10-11

Both shared editors now use CLEAR / EFFACER. Eight actual-VM combinations (English/French,640×480/1280×800, keyboard/on-screen keyboard) passed reviewed clear/cancel flows. A later edit cancelled after clearing leaves the draft empty when reopened; saved configuration is unchanged. The rejected original French overlap remains recorded.

Proof: `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-network-cloud-management/editor/review.json`, the bound frames/results, and final ES syntax/build receipts. Source and canonical flow/changelog changes remain uncommitted with #535–539 while the scoped independent review is pending; no pin promotion or deployed fix is claimed.

## Verified source delivery — 2026-10-11T16:27:55.227775+00:00

Distribution [bc2dceb406](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/commit/bc2dceb406969a401d987de168acfb3ae60b7e01) and ES [c8dc72cf9e](https://github.com/pixelelated/emulationstation/commit/c8dc72cf9ec00ab00d6c4a9fcdcea1746c6f1f78) are integrated and pushed. Final delivery head `849e8dd3126a43f53abcae2678622c75ef85a08f` has successful exact-head hosted record and private-word checks. [Canonical flow/evidence packet](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/849e8dd3126a43f53abcae2678622c75ef85a08f/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-network-cloud-management); [independent audit, all seven repairs and Phase7 resolution](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/849e8dd3126a43f53abcae2678622c75ef85a08f/docs/audits/2026_10_11-epic-m7-network-cloud-344).

AC1: both editor captions and final syntax/build checks. AC2: eight reviewed EN/FR640/1280 keyboard/OSK Clear→cancel→reopen flows in editor/review.json. AC3: canonical references, exact-source bindings, original rejected overlap and published ES pin.

Only owned VM/local synthetic endpoints were used. The source fix is delivered; no new firmware image, owner-device update or personal-cloud action is claimed. Combined-image release qualification remains under #344/#537.
